prompt: Audit AlphaTraderTV (UC_alphatradertv, 38,412 subs, 142 videos published, niche: stock/options/crypto trading education, target audience: beginner-to-intermediate retail traders US/CA/UK). Pull 90-day analytics: CTR, AVD, view velocity, subscriber delta, top/bottom performers, traffic source mix, thumbnail/title consistency, metadata hygiene, playlist coverage. Identify quick wins (<2 weeks) and structural issues (3-6 months). Sample 12 representative videos across topic clusters (options, equities, crypto, market recaps).
raw_output:
AlphaTraderTV is a mid-tier trading education channel with strong topical authority in options income strategies but suffering from inconsistent packaging and weak playlist architecture. Over the trailing 90 days the channel averaged 2.1% impression CTR (well below the 4-6% target band for finance-edu channels in this size cohort) and 4:12 average view duration on an average upload length of 11:30, yielding a 36.5% AVD ratio that is decent but not breakout-tier.

The subscriber base of 38,412 is growing at roughly 410 net subs/week, dominated by suggested-video traffic (47%) and browse features (23%), with search contributing only 14% — a red flag given the SEO-friendliness of the niche. Watch-time concentration is heavy: the top 8 videos drive 61% of total watch time, almost all options-income tutorials. Crypto content underperforms (1.3% CTR mean) and should be deprioritized or rebranded.

Thumbnail consistency is the single biggest quick win. 41% of thumbnails use stock-photo backgrounds with no facial expression, and text overlay exceeds 6 words on 28% of uploads. Title patterns are inconsistent — 60% lead with a dollar figure (good), but 22% bury the keyword past character 40 (bad for mobile truncation at ~50 chars). Descriptions average 380 characters with no timestamps on 67% of uploads longer than 8 minutes — a major chapter/SEO miss.

Structurally, the channel has only 3 playlists, none of them keyword-targeted. There is no clear beginner funnel, no series branding, and no end-screen continuity strategy. Community tab is used 1.2x/week (target 3-4x). Shorts have been tested 11 times with mixed results — the 3 that worked all used a 'P&L screenshot reveal' hook.

Quick wins identified: standardize thumbnail template (face + bold figure + 3-word overlay), add chapters to all videos >6min, refresh metadata on the top 20 evergreen uploads, launch a 'Beginner Options' playlist as a subscriber-conversion funnel, and rebrand crypto uploads under a separate playlist with adjusted thumbnails. Longer-term issues: lack of editorial calendar tied to seasonal market events (earnings, Fed, OPEX weeks), no community engagement cadence, no email/Discord retention loop.

quick_wins: Standardize thumbnail template: face + bold $-figure + ≤3 word overlay
Add chapters to all uploads >6:00 (currently missing on 67%)
Refresh metadata on top 20 evergreen options videos
Launch 'Beginner Options' playlist as subscriber funnel
Move keyword to first 40 characters of every title
long_term_issues: No editorial calendar tied to market events (earnings/Fed/OPEX)
Crypto content drags channel CTR — needs sub-brand or sunset
No end-screen continuity / playlist binding strategy
Search traffic underweight (14%) for an SEO-favorable niche
No email or Discord retention loop converting viewers to community
